name: Interactive Voice Response
description: Voice self-service system that greets inbound callers, identifies them, and attempts to complete requests without an agent through menus, speech recognition, and data integrations.
roleInCenter: First-line containment: resolve simple intents automatically and hand off richer context when an agent is needed.

glossary.definition: The directed graph of prompts, menus, and logic a caller traverses
Dual-tone multi-frequency input: keypad presses selected during or instead of speech
Automatic speech recognition converting caller speech to text for NLU matching
Text-to-speech rendering of prompts; alternative is studio-recorded talent
The bounded vocabulary ASR listens for at a given prompt node
Mid-call lookup into a backend (CRM, OMS, billing) to personalize or branch the flow
Caller completes their need inside IVR without transfer to a live resource
Caller presses 0 (or says agent) to force transfer to a queue, bypassing self-service
Caller may speak over a prompt, interrupting playback to speed navigation
Automatic number identification: calling-party phone number used for identity match
ASR heard something outside the grammar; triggers reprompt or error path
IVR offers to hold the caller's place in queue and call them back instead of waiting

children.name: Navigational
children.description: Route the caller to the correct department or skill

children.name: Open-Phrase Routing
children.description: Free speech maps directly to intent/queue

children.name: Callback Scheduling
children.description: Reserve a place in queue for later contact

children.name: Transferred
children.description: Routed to a live queue with context

children.name: Multilingual Variant
children.description: Localized flow versions with own talent/grammars

metrics.name: IVR Containment Rate
metrics.definition: Share of IVR calls that finish without live-agent transfer

metrics.name: Flow Completion Rate
metrics.definition: Share of callers entering a self-service flow who reach its success end

metrics.name: Zero-Out Rate
metrics.definition: Share of calls where the caller requests an agent explicitly

metrics.name: Average IVR Time
metrics.definition: Mean time in IVR before transfer, containment, or abandon

metrics.name: No-Match Rate
metrics.definition: Share of speech turns that fail grammar matching and trigger reprompt

metrics.name: Callback Acceptance Rate
metrics.definition: Share of eligible long-wait callers who accept a callback instead of holding

failureModes.name: Menu Maze
failureModes.signal: Containment drops with menu depth; zero-outs spike at level 3+
failureModes.mitigation: Flatten to 3 levels, open-phrase routing at entry

failureModes.name: Ambiguous Prompts
failureModes.signal: No-match and repeated-keypress clusters on specific nodes
failureModes.mitigation: Rewrite prompt to distinctive vocabulary; A/B test grammars

failureModes.name: Blind Transfer
failureModes.signal: Repeated calls and low FCR on transferred segments
failureModes.mitigation: Attach call context and data-dip results to transfer; consider warm transfer for complex intents

failureModes.name: Stale Flow Content
failureModes.signal: Complaints and repeat contacts about wrong hours, prices, policy in IVR
failureModes.mitigation: Flow content linked to KM single source of truth with review cycle

failureModes.name: ANI Fraud / Wrong-Party
failureModes.signal: Auth failures spike on one flow; verify claims from VOC verbatims
failureModes.mitigation: Stronger authentication strength rules step-up before transactions

exchanges: verification state and account context on transfer
Transfer with selected skill queue and priority
Dynamic content retrieval for informational prompts
IVR turn transcripts for intent and abandon analysis

scoringModel.name: IVR Self-Service Containment & Acoustic Health Scorecard
scoringModel.note: Evaluates voice self-service containment, acoustic ASR confidence stability, prompt ergonomics, and context continuity on live transfers.

dimensions.name: True Self-Service Containment & Task Completion
dimensions.description: End-to-end completion of informational and transactional flows without zero-out or repeat contact within 24 hours
sampleCriteria: Caller reaches terminal success node without agent transfer
Zero-out hazard stays below threshold across menu turns
No repeat inbound call on identical intent within 24 hours

dimensions.name: Acoustic ASR & Grammar Recognition Precision
dimensions.description: Posterior recognition confidence across caller utterances, grammar coverage, and resilience to background noise
sampleCriteria: First-turn ASR posterior confidence exceeds 0.85 threshold
No-match reprompts occur on fewer than 8 percent of turns
Barge-in speech endpointing captures complete caller utterance

dimensions.name: Prompt Friction & Navigation Ergonomics
dimensions.description: Menu depth discipline, concise TTS phrasing, and calibrated barge-in responsiveness minimizing caller cognitive load
sampleCriteria: Tree traversal completes in 3 or fewer menu levels
Prompt duration stays under 12 seconds per turn
Full-duplex barge-in halts playback within 150 milliseconds

dimensions.name: Data-Dip Personalization & Context Handoff
dimensions.description: Sub-second CRM lookup for proactive status readouts and lossless attachment of verified context on queue transfer
sampleCriteria: ANI data dip resolves account context prior to first menu branch
Verified authentication state and slot values pass to ACD screen pop
Eligible high-wait transfers receive accurate EWT callback offer

dimensions.name: Error Recovery & Fallback Governance
dimensions.description: Graceful multimodal or DTMF fallback after recognition failure without trapping callers in reprompt loops
sampleCriteria: Automatic switch to DTMF keypad grammar after second no-match
Immediate warm routing to skilled queue on third recognition failure
Dynamic outage announcements governed by current KM source of truth

stateVariables.description: Continuous acoustic and lexical posterior probability assigned to the top grammar or NLU intent hypothesis at time t
Instantaneous hazard rate of caller DTMF keypress or speech barge-in interrupting active prompt playback
Cumulative cognitive and temporal friction integral accrued across menu depth, reprompts, and TTS latency
Continuous survival probability that the caller remains contained in self-service without zero-out or hang-up through time t
Instantaneous hazard rate of explicit zero-out transfer or frustration hang-up driven by accumulated prompt friction

differentialEquations.name: Containment Survival Probability Evolution
differentialEquations.formula: S_ivr(t) = exp(-integral_0^t h_zero(tau) dtau), with dS_ivr(t) cdot dt^-1 = -h_zero(t) cdot S_ivr(t)
differentialEquations.interpretation: Containment survival decays exponentially with the integrated zero-out and abandonment hazard intensity along the call trajectory

differentialEquations.name: Cumulative Prompt Friction Integral Dynamics
differentialEquations.formula: dF_ivr(t) cdot dt^-1 = alpha_depth cdot L_menu(t) + beta_err cdot (1 - c_asr(t)) + gamma_wait cdot I_reprompt(t)
differentialEquations.interpretation: Prompt friction accumulates continuously with menu depth level L_menu, ASR recognition uncertainty (1 - c_asr), and reprompt indicator penalties

differentialEquations.name: Acoustic ASR Confidence Trajectory SDE
differentialEquations.formula: dc_asr(t) = kappa_asr cdot (c_grammar(t) - c_asr(t)) dt - eta_noise cdot h_barge(t) cdot c_asr(t) dt + sigma_asr dW_t
differentialEquations.interpretation: ASR confidence mean-reverts toward grammar acoustic clarity while premature barge-in collisions and channel noise induce stochastic drops

scaleInvariants: O(1) per-turn state update complexity via recursive sufficient statistics on (c_asr, F_ivr, S_ivr) across 100k+ concurrent IVR ports
Memoryless hazard additivity: composite exit intensity equals the sum of independent zero-out, no-match exhaustion, and timeout hazards
Time-rescaling invariance: transforming prompt clock time by cumulative hazard integral maps heterogeneous call flows onto a unit-rate exponential survival curve
